items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I worked with Hepburn, Richard Barthelmus, (PHONETIC)

ctx.x: Do you remember any particular films

Well, I worked with all of the stars and things in those days. I worked with Hepburn, Richard Barthelmus, (PHONETIC), these are all people that you wouldn't really know about. Back with -- oh, gee. I never was much for names, but I worked with so many people. I just -- they all just run together in my head. I was never a person to actually remember too much about pictures, because I had seen so many of them made in person that there was no fantasy in my mind about how a picture should be made because I knew that…

I worked in Westerns, all of those sort of things in those days, whatever there was to do, I worked at them. As a matter of fact, I even rode a few horses and things in Westerns when I was a young kid.
